patterns: Nehru as author is a favourite: Discovery of India (written in Ahmednagar Fort jail), A Bunch of Old Letters (1958, APPSC).
Quote attribution ('Everything else can wait, but not agriculture') and 'which influence is NOT true' (German nationalism) are standard one-liners.
Chronology of Nehru-era events (Khrushchev visit 1955, Dalai Lama 1959, Chou visit 1960, Goa 1961) is a repeated sequencing question.
APPSC asks institution years directly (UGC statutory 1956); app adds many multi-statement items on plans, NDC and Bandung that go beyond PYQ depth but are sound.
